description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the TimeConfigPeriodAPI in the OrangeHRM system. It includes test methods for retrieving, updating, and deleting time configuration periods via the API, using mock services and fixtures to simulate different scenarios.

classes.name: TimeConfigPeriodAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that tests the TimeConfigPeriodAPI endpoints including getOne, update, delete, and validation rules within the OrangeHRM Time module.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single time configuration period using the API, with fixtures and mock services.

methods.name: getOnePreHook
methods.description: A setup hook that modifies a configuration entity before running the 'getOne' test.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating a time configuration period through the API using mocked user and services.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Verifies that the delete operation throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Ensures that the validation rules for delete are not implemented and throw an exception.
